h1: Custom Mixie Putty for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Mixie putty for your brand. Perfect for stress relief and giveaways. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Mixie putty offers a unique, non-toxic stress relief option that stands out from standard promotional putty. Its soft, squishy texture and vibrant colors make it a favorite at trade shows and corporate events. Available in custom colors with your logo imprinted, Mixie putty is an affordable giveaway that employees and customers will actually use. Order in bulk for your next campaign.
heroAltText: Custom Mixie putty in bright colors with company logo imprinted, perfect for promotional giveaways
